answer: To limit alias rewards for AI reports of hollow opal or jade beads, give each fixed-registry sponsor 10 lifetime admission vouchers and a 10-credit/day tree-wide cap. Each key consumes one voucher; child keys mint none. Ledger validators enforce the cap and check signatures and voucher reuse; failure denies payment. Sponsors can sell or hoard access; neither owner uniqueness nor grading accuracy follows. Hardware is reusable, compute recurs, no stake. Ten concurrent keys on shared hosts consume ten nonrecyclable rights yet share at most 10 credits/day.
